lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples the crowd has been with Him three days and has nothing to eat.
Jesus takes the loaves, gives thanks, and the people eat and are satisfied, leaving twelve basketfuls of broken pieces.
After Jesus dismisses the crowd, He gets into the boat with His disciples and goes to Bethsaida.
The Pharisees argue with Jesus and demand a sign from heaven, but He says no sign will be given.
The disciples have one loaf in the boat, and Jesus warns of the leaven of the Pharisees and Herod.
